      Winners
      9Matt

      3 weeks above average, and the climb from 7th is now a proper charge. Not a one-week fluke. Nikhil will be checking his mirrors.

      9Hishaan

      The only manager brave enough to back Barry with the armband. Brave, lucky or both? The league will say lucky. Hishaan will say visionary.

      8Inesh

      Tzolakis, started by nobody else, quietly paid off. Isak in as a signing, too. Sensible week, and sometimes sensible is the cheeky move.

      Losers
      2Ravi Mahtani

      Worst week of the season, and the Wooden Spoon to show for it. Vanessa has snatched the bragging rights back. The tide keeps turning.

      2Rohan

      5th-time Captain of the Week winner, yet this time the armband went to Haaland too. The man who knows captaincy got it wrong.

      Decision of the week
      Hishaan ignored the crowd and put the armband on Barry. It brought 32 against the 4 that Haaland's captains got. A 28-point swing, and the bravest call of the week.
      One to watch in GW11
      Nikhil against Matt, with just 1 point between them. Nikhil has led for 3 weeks, but Matt has the form. If either of them backs the wrong captain, the lead could flip again.

      How it's worked out

      Each manager gets a 0-100 score from three things, across every gameweek this season (10 so far): how many of the league picked the same captain (45%), how many of their 11 are in most other teams (45%), and points spent on hits (10%). The fewer people you copy, the more daring you are. 50 is your league's average manager. Ghosts (no transfers or chips in 3+ gameweeks) aren't rated.
